caseNameFull: Transit Homes, Inc. v. Mastropole et ux.
judges: Are, Carolina, Cer, Granted, Should, Supreme

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. S. C. Certiorari denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Blackmun are of the opinion that cer-tiorari should be granted and the judgment of the Supreme Court of South Carolina reversed.
